3.text:
Testifier:
Sue Chase, Superintendent, Cass Lake-Bena School District

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 4350, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 3618: Senator Gruenhagen: Watertown construction materials refundable tax
exemption provision.

Senator Weber moved the A-1 amendment. The motion prevailed and the A-1 amendment was
adopted.

Testifier:
Michael Walters, Mayor, Watertown

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 3618, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 3170: Senator Nelson: Rochester exemption provision for construction materials for a
sports and recreation complex.

Senator Nelson moved the A-1 amendment. The motion prevailed and the A-1 amendment was
adopted.

Testifier:
Shaun Palmer, City Councilmember, Rochester

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 3170, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 3752: Senator Hauschild: Lake Superior School District construction project sales and
use tax exemption provision and appropriation.

Testifier:
Tanner Spawn, Business Manager, Lake Superior School District

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 3752 be laid over.

S.F. 4868: Senator Hauschild: St. Louis County housing development projects sales and use
tax exemption for certain construction materials.

Senator Hauschild moved the A-5 amendment. The motion prevailed and the A-5 amendment
was adopted.

Testifier:
Annie Harala, Commissioner, St. Louis County

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 4868, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 1289: Senator Hauschild: Property tax exemption modification for certain airport
property.

Senator Hauschild moved the A-1 amendment. The motion prevailed and the A-1 amendment
was adopted.

Testifiers:
Dante Tomassoni, Director of Corporate Affairs, Cirrus Aircraft
Tom Werner, Executive Director, Duluth International Airport

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 1289, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 2365: Senator Hauschild: Graduates of aerospace and aviation-related educational
programs and employers of program graduates income tax credit authorization.

Senator Hauschild moved the A-2 amendment. The motion prevailed and the A-2 amendment
was adopted.
